ब्रेड पिट की फिल्म हार्ट ऑफ द बीस्ट का बॉक्स ऑफिस सफर अब खत्म होने की कगार पर है! 🎬
क्रिटिक्स और ऑडियंस से पॉजिटिव रेटिंग मिलने के बावजूद फिल्म कमाई में थोड़ा पीछे रह गई। 🍿
बॉक्स ऑफिस Mojo की रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, फिल्म का वर्ल्डवाइड कलेक्शन 188.7 मिलियन डॉलर हो चुका है। 💰
इंडस्ट्री के अनुमान के मुताबिक, 82 मिलियन डॉलर के बजट वाली इस फिल्म को ब्रेक-ईवन के लिए 205 मिलियन डॉलर कमाने थे। 📉
रिपोर्ट्स का कहना है कि फिल्म लगभग 200 मिलियन डॉलर पर सिमट जाएगी और 5 मिलियन डॉलर से चूक जाएगी। 🤫

ctx.text:
Heart of the Beast starring Brad Pitt is not yet dead at the box office, but its theatrical run is coming to an end. The film is still struggling to hit its second major milestone at the worldwide box office. However, according to the latest estimates, it will fall short of the break-even target for its final global total by a few million. Keep scrolling for the deets.
According to reports, it is one of Brad Pitt’s top 20 highest-grossing films. It received positive ratings from critics and audiences. Still, somehow the film could not convert them into cash at the box office. It is achieving minor milestones worldwide by beating other movies at the box office, but not much else.
According to Box Office Mojo , Heart of the Beast is on track to cross the $200 million milestone at the worldwide box office. It collected $1.2 million on its 7th three-day weekend at the North American box office, down 25.5% from last weekend, despite losing 535 theaters on Friday. It has reached $67.2 million in domestic cume. When added to the latest overseas gross, the film’s worldwide collection is $188.7 million . It is less than $15 million away from surpassing the $200 million milestone worldwide.
According to industry estimates, Heart of the Beast is on track to end its global run at around $200 million . However, with a reported production budget of $82 million , the Brad Pitt starrer needs to earn approximately $205 million worldwide to break even, according to the industry’s 2.5x rule. If it wraps up its theatrical run at $200 million , it will fall just $5 million short of the break-even mark, making it a rather disappointing outcome.
The film follows Special Forces veteran James Belmont and his combat dog, Odin, who find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness after a harrowing plane crash. Together, they must battle the unforgiving elements in a brutal fight for survival. Heart of the Beast , starring Brad Pitt and JK Simmons , was released on September 25.
